name: ANTIQUE
description: Considering the widespread use of mobile and voice search, answer passage retrieval for non-factoid questions plays a critical role in modern information retrieval systems. Despite the importance of the task, the community still feels the significant lack of large-scale non-factoid question answering collections with real questions and comprehensive relevance judgments. In this paper, we develop and release a collection of 2,626 open-domain non-factoid questions from a diverse set of categories. The dataset, called ANTIQUE, contains 34,011 manual relevance annotations. The questions were asked by real users in a community question answering service, i.e., Yahoo! Answers. Relevance judgments for all the answers to each question were collected through crowdsourcing. To facilitate further research, we also include a brief analysis of the data as well as baseline results on both classical and recently developed neural IR models.
evaluation_method: MAP (mean average precision) / MRR / nDCG (MAP reported as primary)
reputation: A well-known dataset in the IR community for non-factoid question answering and passage retrieval, though smaller and older than many recent benchmarks.
notes: Relatively small collection (2,626 questions) from Yahoo! Answers; contains real user queries and crowdsourced judgments but may include noise and topical drift; non-LLM benchmark primarily used in classical and neural IR research.
